title: Treaty of Kyakhta (1727)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Kyakhta (1727)", at revision 1380280899, opens: "The Treaty of Kyakhta, along with the Treaty of Nerchinsk (1689), regulated the relations between Imperial Russia and the Qing Empire of China until the mid-19th century. It was signed by Tulišen and Count Sava Lukich Raguzinskii-Vladislavich at the border city of Kyakhta on 23 August 1727." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q715967, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1727 treaty between Qing China and Imperial Russia". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
